'''Hadrik''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Shaman/Legends|Shaman]] who lived on [[Voss]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was one of the only Gormak capable of using the Force, specifically an ability known as Dream-walking. However, he kept this a secret, as Gormak believed all things to do with the Force was corruption and must be destroyed. Hadrik always wanted to fly off-world to avoid his [[Species/Legends|species']] conflict with the [[Voss (species)|Voss]], as he believe the Gormak could achieve much more if they stopped fighting the Voss and each other. The Gormak King, [[Jokull]], had him imprisoned for his beliefs.<ref name="Necessary Sacrifice" /> His chance for freedom arrived in the form of a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], who arrived on Voss in search of a cure for their [[Force walk]] sickness. Hadrik helped Kallig with a cure, and in exchange Kallig transported Hadrik out of his homeworld despite the objections of the Voss Mystics, who claimed there would be dire consequences if a Gormak were allowed to reach the stars.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Darth Nox|Sith Inquisitor]]|The Ritual|[[Voss]]}}</ref>
